name: Kurokawa Saki
source:
A 1st-year student at Marenis High School.
A member of the Occult Research Club whose hobby is fortune-telling.
She loves and respects the heroine.
She has a personality similar to a friendly puppy.

"Won't you upperclassmen join the Occult Research Club too!?"

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=8]official website[/url]]
